crossRefs.note: As the deer pants for the water brooks, so my soul pants after you, God.
They shall come and shall declare his righteousness to a people that shall be born, for he has done it.
Yes, even when I am old and gray-haired, God, don’t forsake me, until I have declared your strength to the next…
Which we have heard and known, and our fathers have told us.
Give thanks to Yahweh! Call on his name! Make his doings known among the peoples.
Sing to him, sing praises to him! Tell of all his marvelous works.
You shall observe this thing for an ordinance to you and to your sons forever.
It shall be, when your son asks you in time to come, saying, ‘What is this?’ that you shall tell him, ‘By strength of…
When Pharaoh stubbornly refused to let us go, Yahweh killed all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, both the firstborn…
The living, the living, he shall praise you, as I do today. The father shall make known your truth to the children.
Tell your children about it, and have your children tell their children, and their children, another generation.
Therefore it is said in the book of the Wars of Yahweh, “Vaheb in Suphah, the valleys of the Arnon,
Therefore those who speak in proverbs say, “Come to Heshbon. Let the city of Sihon be built and established;
“Please inquire of past generations. Find out about the learning of their fathers.
(For we are but of yesterday, and know nothing, because our days on earth are a shadow.)
“I will show you, listen to me; that which I have seen I will declare

translations.web: We have heard with our ears, God; our fathers have told us what work you did in their days, in the days of old.
translations.bsb: We have heard with our ears, O God; our fathers have told us the work You did in their days, in the days of old.
translations.kjv: We have heard with our ears, O God, our fathers have told us, what work thou didst in their days, in the times of old.
translations.asv: We have heard with our ears, O God, Our fathers have told us, What work thou didst in their days, In the days of old.
